text: FCLoopRemoveNegativePropagatorPowers[exp] rewrites propagators raised to integer powers as products.
ex // StandardForm (*-m + Pair[Momentum[q, D], Momentum[q, D]]*)
SFAD[{q, m}, q + p, {q, m, -2}] ex = FCLoopRemoveNegativePropagatorPowers[%]
ex // StandardForm (*FeynAmpDenominator[StandardPropagatorDenominator[Momentum[p, D] + Momentum[q, D], 0, 0, {1, 1}]] (-m + Pair[Momentum[q, D], Momentum[q, D]])*)
